subjective.text: Patrick Smith is thirty five years old with date of birth October seventh, ninety three something.
Patrick has been experiencing headaches that come and go during work times.
The headaches are mostly in the front of his head but can sometimes affect other parts of his body like arms or breathing.
Patrick has noticed tingling in both hands and feet but not in legs.
He feels short of breath sometimes when sitting at his desk or exercising.
Patrick has noticed a reduced appetite and weight loss (five pounds).
He feels hot but does not mention any fever.
Patrick has noticed a loss of libido at home and mentions this to the doctor.
Patrick drinks once a week and does not smoke or use recreational drugs.

assessment.text: Patrick is experiencing multiple symptoms including headaches, tingling sensations, shortness of breath, and weight loss which may be related to his job stress.
His symptoms suggest a need for further investigation including an examination of his heart and breathing as well as blood tests to check on his thyroxine levels.

plan.text: Book an appointment with one of the doctors in the clinic for further examination and testing; prescribe no medications at this time as they need to see him in person first.
